name: Nichijou o Todokeru Fujiwara-kun no Tegami ~ 1-tsuume - Hamburg ni Medamayaki ga Nokkaranai Jijou
original_name: 日常を届ける藤原くんの手紙～１通目　ハンバーグに目玉焼きがのっからない事情
source:
Does a fried egg "stick" on a Hamburg steak? Or not?

The advisor of the newspaper club, Mr Sato tells the club members about the shock of not having a fried egg on their home-made Hamburg steak and the reasons why.
What was the answer they came up with in the midst of their mixed thoughts?

"I want to eat a Hamburg steak. One with a fried egg on it!!"
translation:
煎鸡蛋会“粘”在汉堡牛排上吗？或不？

报纸俱乐部的顾问佐藤先生向俱乐部成员讲述了他们自制的汉堡牛排上没有煎鸡蛋的震惊及其原因。
他们百思不得其解，得出的答案是什么？

“我想吃汉堡牛排，上面加一个煎蛋！！”
